description: Move `billing` (incl. `credits` + `commerce-admin`) handlers/services — `StripeService`, `PaymentSettingsService`, `PaymentAnomalyService`, `APIKeyService`, `LimitsService`, `UsageService` — into `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/domain/billing/` with exported `RegisterRoutes(router, deps)`. Update `routes.go` to call `billing.RegisterRoutes` instead of `registerBillingRoutes` + `registerCommerceAdminRoutes` + `registerCreditsRoutes`. Remove the moved fields from the `Server` struct. This is the heaviest domain (Stripe webhooks, reconciliation, payment anomaly logging — see existing `lpbs-stripe-reconciliation-ticker` and `lpbs-checkout-webhook-atomicity` items); coordinate with those if active. Behavior-preserving: webhook idempotency, anomaly detection, credit accounting unchanged. Acceptance: tests pass; `api/domain/billing` package exists; old register functions removed; no cycles.
name: lpbs-api-extract-billing-domain
title: Extract LPBS billing domain into api/domain/billing/
